additions: When enabled, limited guidance history records session times, topics, confirmed student references, language, connection events, model configuration references and official-source links for 90 days. It does not store audio or a transcript. Accepted academic profile changes, plan revisions, optional helpfulness feedback and self-reported progress also have 90-day cleanup schedules. These records are private; institution reports do not receive them. Onboarding diagnostic records have a retention period of 7 to 90 days, with 90 days as the default. Scheduled cleanup runs periodically rather than at the exact expiration time.
